title: [WT-17] Docs: worktree-mode contracts in MCP_SERVER, SCHEMA and CONFIGURATION
definitionOfDone: docs/MCP_SERVER.md documents `workspace` on claim_next_task and get_context, the complete_task worktree branch rule, and finalize_attempt 'unlanded' with its three params and routing.
docs/SCHEMA.md documents ProjectSettings.worktreeMode, ExecutionAttempt.workspaceMode/workspace and Task.landingRetry with field types matching types/schema.ts.

docs/CONFIGURATION.md documents worktreeMode (default off), the five env vars, the git-land-<target> resource, refs/moe/board, moe/control and every new MOE_WORKTREE_/MOE_LAND_/MOE_CONTROL_/MOE_BOARD_ code found by grep in scripts/moe-agent.sh.
Every name in those docs matches the landed code (a grep of each documented code in scripts/moe-agent.sh and moe-agent.ps1 finds it).

comments.content: Spike self-review correction (epic rail 2: parity-check must pass on every task). Append this to this task's verification command, run from the repo root: `&& S=$(mktemp -d) && git archive HEAD scripts | tar -x -C "$S" && (cd "$S" && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh)`. Running it on a HEAD snapshot keeps a peer's mid-edit wrapper bytes from failing a docs-only task.

comments.content:
Contract additions from WT-03 (task-9a39bf6a) to document once:
- MCP_SERVER.md, finalize_attempt:
  - outcome 'unlanded', with params unlandedReason (conflict|contention|gate|diverged|remote), conflictPaths, rescueRef (refs/moe/rescue/<taskId>/<ts>) and targetTip; worktree attempts only.
  - Routing: REVIEW to WORKING, or to BLOCKED (blockedFromStatus WORKING) for 'diverged' or the 3rd consecutive unlanded.
  - New response fields taskStatus and landingRetry. 'landed' and 'nothing-to-commit' clear landingRetry.
- get_context: task.landingRetry, when set.
- SCHEMA.md: Task.landingRetry {reason, paths, rescueRef, targetTip, count, at} | null, and UnlandedReason.
